'''Sanglechi''' is a [[Pamiri language]] spoken in villages in the [[Zebak District]] of [[Afghanistan]]: Dashte Rubat, [[Eskatul]], Faruq, Flaxmadek, Sar-Sanglech, and Takya.<ref name=e25/> It is also spoken in [[Tajikistan]], where it is called '''Sanglich'''.{{cn|date=December 2022}} The name originates from the Sanglech Valley, in which many of the people live. The language is closely related to the [[Munji language|Munji]] and [[Pashto]] languages of Afghanistan.
